title: Mutual Inductor
text: Model two coupled inductors for circuit envelope analysis; {Inductance L1} sets the inductance of first inductor, {Inductance L2} sets the inductance of second inductor and {Coefficient of coupling}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inductance L1
params.values: Inductance of first inductor 1e-6 H (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Inductance L2
params.values: Inductance of second inductor 1e-6 H (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Coefficient of coupling
params.values: Coefficient of coupling for mutual inductance 0.9 (default) | scalar
